svg.title: The toolbox — index, part 1: AI and Build
svg.desc: The toolbox — index, part 1 of 2, A–Z: every tool I ship with, and the work in this issue it appears in. AI (models, gateways, SDKs): AI Gateway (Cloudflare) — in DualMind Arena (Fig. 2); Claude — in AI Support Agent (Fig. 8); Cursor SDK — in AI Component Builder (Fig. 7); Gemini (Google) — in PixelProof (Fig. 5); Nemotron (NVIDIA) — in Ratchet (Fig. 3); OpenAI — in AI Support Agent (Fig. 8). Build (languages & frameworks): C#; Dart — in MealMind (Fig. 9); FastAPI — in Ratchet (Fig. 3); Flutter — in MealMind (Fig. 9); JavaScript — in PixelProof (Fig. 5); .NET — in DualMind Arena (Fig. 2); Next.js — in AI Component Builder (Fig. 7); Node.js — in AI Support Agent (Fig. 8); Python — in Ratchet (Fig. 3); React — in ModVigil (Fig. 6) and AI Component Builder (Fig. 7); TypeScript — in ModVigil (Fig. 6) and AI Component Builder (Fig. 7).
